notes.zh: 不在支持范围 2024-2027 内，没有注册（ADR-0009）
notes.en: Outside the supported range 2024-2027, so nothing was registered (ADR-0009)

notes.zh: 这个 EPLAN 没有按要求关闭，请自己关闭它
notes.en: This EPLAN did not close when asked; close it yourself

problem.zh: Pro Panel 的 EPLAN 正在运行，或有无法判断变体的 EPLAN 在运行（进程 3388）：这时执行命令会另起一个装着全部插件的 EPLAN。请先关闭它，然后重新运行
problem.en: EPLAN of Pro Panel, or one whose variant cannot be told, is running (process 3388): the command would start a second EPLAN with every add-in. Close it and run again

problem.zh: EPLAN（进程 4120）没有在等待时间内启动完成（插件没有加载），所以没有关闭它：如果它显示登录或授权对话框，请处理后等它启动完成，再自己关闭 EPLAN，然后运行 eplanmcp doctor 检查
problem.en: EPLAN (process 4120) did not finish starting in time (the add-in did not load), so it was left open: if it shows a sign-in or licence dialog, complete it and let EPLAN start, close EPLAN yourself, then check with eplanmcp doctor

problem.zh: 支持范围内的 EPLAN 中没有安装这些变体，没有注册任何变体：Fluid (installed: Electric P8, Pro Panel)
problem.en: No EPLAN in the supported range has these variants, so nothing was registered: Fluid (installed: Electric P8, Pro Panel)
